Read a GROMACS .xvg file

Source: R/xvg_readers.R
read_xvg.Rd

Reads the analysis output GROMACS writes as .xvg (gmx rms, gmx rmsf, gmx gyrate, gmx hbond, gmx energy, ...) into a long data frame for the mdTrajectoryMetrics module. # comment lines are skipped; the @ title, axis labels and series legends are kept; Grace formatting codes such as \\sX\\N (subscript) are removed from labels. The file may be gzip-compressed. Several files - replicas, or different analyses - can be combined with rbind().

Usage

read_xvg(file, series = NULL)

Arguments

file

Path to a .xvg file.

series

Optional names for the data series (the y columns), e.g. a replica name for a single-series file. Defaults to the file's legends, or the file name when it has none.

Value

A data frame with one row per point: x, value, series, metric (the file's title), x.label, y.label and file.

See also

mdTrajectoryMetrics(), the mdTrajectoryMetrics module

Author

Jared Andrews

Examples

rmsd <- read_xvg(system.file("extdata", "example_rmsd_rep1.xvg.gz", package = "sciVizModules"),
    series = "replica 1")
head(rmsd)
#>     x   value    series metric   x.label   y.label              file
#> 1   0 0.00000 replica 1   RMSD Time (ps) RMSD (nm) example_rmsd_rep1
#> 2 100 0.01225 replica 1   RMSD Time (ps) RMSD (nm) example_rmsd_rep1
#> 3 200 0.01587 replica 1   RMSD Time (ps) RMSD (nm) example_rmsd_rep1
#> 4 300 0.02164 replica 1   RMSD Time (ps) RMSD (nm) example_rmsd_rep1
#> 5 400 0.01884 replica 1   RMSD Time (ps) RMSD (nm) example_rmsd_rep1
#> 6 500 0.02131 replica 1   RMSD Time (ps) RMSD (nm) example_rmsd_rep1
